problem_statement:
Slow load times for translation Opportunities

**Describe the bug**
opportunitiessummaryhandler/translation takes 6-7 seconds to execute on production

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
 1. Go to 'Oppia.org'
 2. Click on 'Translate text'
 3. Open network tab in inspector
 4. Select a language/ or click on the pagination icons
 4. See error

**Observed behavior**
Slow load times for translation opportunities

**Expected behavior**
Should have similar load times to question opportunities which are aprx 400 ms to 1 second vs 6- 7 seconds we are seeing here

**Screenshots**
![Screen Shot 2021-12-01 at 12 56 27 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35385366/144312712-8388cf71-29a3-4000-83fa-0c93396f035d.png)
